description: Read a saved organization template by id or a known public catalog template by slug. The answer is a summary: the media and value parameters with their kinds and options, presets with their values and brand kit, the brand kit, rubric, components (id, version, asset slots) and an outline of the tracks and clips; never component sources (read one with get_component_source, or pass full: true for the whole document). Use the exact reference with start_template or apply_template. Do not invent a slug from a component-library card.

full.description: Return the whole template document, component sources included, instead of the summary.

name: get_template

document.description: A CueFrame template document (kernel TemplateDocument): v: 1, slug, name, composition with {{name}} references, parameters, components by value, an optional brandKit, presets, rubric, gallery and provenance.

title: Get Template
